assets.source: Original project procedural 64x64 RGBA smoke mask; generated synchronously by app/render/smoke/exhaust.gd

limitations: Combustion startup/shutdown, temperature, mixture, smoke-oil depletion and emissions rates are not physically modeled.
Only the Stik authors an installed RC exhaust anchor; other healthy propulsion types stay clear.
Puff entrainment/expansion/opacity and pump operating gates are visual estimates.
Dense low-speed pump clouds may surround the airframe; depth fade softens surfaces but is not fluid/solid coupling.
Real radios, other GPU/OS exports, night/intersection breadth and long native memory soak remain unqualified.
